ThingDef.label: plasmid injector
ThingDef.description:
A self-contained biological organ containing a swarm of nanites coded for a plasmid.

Once implanted, the nanites modify the host's genes, forcing some genes to be expressed, while supressing others. 

Plasmid implantation is far from a traumatic process, but the recipent will suffer from flu like symptoms depending on the plasmid's complexity.

During storage and transport, plasmid injectors are kept safe in sealed containers.
